# elemento Provider

The Elemento provider is the Terraform interface to [Elemento Modular Cloud](https://elemento.cloud). It replaces the *many clouds, many providers* model with **one provider** and a destination cloud passed as an argument.

Set `host` to the [Atomosphere](https://elemento.cloud/atomosphere.html) (Meson) endpoint for the backend you intend to use (for example `azure.dev.meson.elemento.cloud` or `upcloud.dev.meson.elemento.cloud`). Resource types stay the same across clouds. Use provider aliases to target more than one cloud in a single root module.

Use the [Portal](https://elemento.cloud) for identity and billing (`portal`) and the Meson host for resource operations (`host`). Arguments may also be supplied with `ELEMENTO_HOST`, `ELEMENTO_USERNAME`, `ELEMENTO_PASSWORD`, and `ELEMENTO_PORTAL`.

```terraform
provider "elemento" {
  host     = "azure.dev.meson.elemento.cloud"
  username = var.elemento_username
  password = var.elemento_password
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) Meson / Atomosphere hostname for the target cloud (for example azure.dev.meson.elemento.cloud). Can also be set via the ELEMENTO_HOST environment variable.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The Elemento API password. Can also be set via the ELEMENTO_PASSWORD environment variable.
- `portal` (String) Portal hostname for authentication and billing. Defaults to portal.elemento.cloud. Can also be set via the ELEMENTO_PORTAL environment variable.
- `username` (String) The Elemento API username. Can also be set via the ELEMENTO_USERNAME environment variable.
